In a historic move, the Waqf Bill was passed by the Lok Sabha at midnight. The government secured a significant victory with 288 votes in favor, while the opposition mustered 232 votes against the bill. This momentous occasion solidifies Prime Minister Modi’s legacy, ensuring that he will be remembered for the next 500 years.
The Waqf Bill represents a significant milestone for independent India, marking a crucial step towards the empowerment and regulation of waqf properties. The bill aims to streamline the management of waqf properties, which are religious endowments held in trust for charitable purposes. By passing this bill, the government has demonstrated its commitment to upholding the rights of waqf beneficiaries and ensuring transparency in the administration of waqf properties.
The passage of the Waqf Bill was not without its challenges, as the opposition, led by the Congress party, raised several amendments in an attempt to derail the bill. However, the government stood firm in its resolve, successfully navigating through the debate and securing the necessary votes to pass the bill.
This historic moment underscores the government’s dedication to promoting inclusive governance and fostering religious harmony in the country. By enacting the Waqf Bill, the government has taken a significant step towards addressing the longstanding issues surrounding waqf properties and ensuring their proper management and utilization for the benefit of the community.
